item.title: Whisper + Timeline TV Women in Sport Networking Event 27 April, 2022 - Timeline Television Ltd.
item.description: Whisper and Timeline Television are calling all women who work in sport production and beyond to attend a Women in Sport Networking Event on Wednesday 27 April, 2022, at Whisper in Kew, 09:30-11:30am.

item.title: Moving on up: Timeline joins the big league with studio and OB fleet expansion - Timeline Television Ltd.
item.description: The UK-based technical services provider Timeline has added a raft of new studios, galleries and trucks to its facilities arsenal as part of a multi-million-pound expansion that brings the company in line with some of Europe’s biggest sports broadcasting suppliers.

item.title: Timeline installs remote production facility at MediaCity - Timeline Television Ltd.
item.description: The UK-based technical services provider Timeline has installed a new remote production hub at its facility in Timeline North, in MediaCity, Salford.

item.title: New Podcast episode in conversation with Whisper CEO Sunil Patel - Timeline Television Ltd.
item.description: In this episode Sarah Essoof chats to Whisper CEO Sunil Patel. In this fascinating chat Sunil shares his honest and interesting insight of how he broke into the television industry and how he came to form Whisper with co-founders: broadcaster Jake Humphrey and former F1 driver David Coulthard.

item.title: Posted at Timeline - Alex Scott: The Future of Women's Football - Timeline Television Ltd.
item.description: Former England international Alex Scott looks at the explosion in popularity of women’s football and asks what the future holds for the game she loves.

item.title: Timeline sponsors Rise Awards 2022 - Timeline Television Ltd.
item.description: We are thrilled to announce we are official partners of the Rise Awards, which are now open for nominations.

item.title: RTS Young Technologist Award for 2022 - Timeline Television Ltd.
item.description: Timeline’s Jonathan Chappell-Seetayah wins the RTS Young Technologist Award for 2022

item.title: Sustainability Podcast - Timeline Television Ltd.
item.description: We have a brand new podcast! We delve into sustainability in the broadcast industry and get an insight into what Sky and Deluxe are doing.

item.title: 2022 Commonwealth Games - Timeline Television Ltd.
item.description: The Commonwealth Games begins next Thursday 28th July and Timeline is proud to be one of Sunset+Vine's broadcast technical partners for the UK’s largest multi-sport event since London 2012.

item.title: Sustainable Production for UEFA Women's Euro 2022 - Timeline Television Ltd.
item.description: Timeline is proud to have supported Whisper on their production of the UEFA Women’s Euro 2022 for BBC Sport. As part of the contract, sustainability is a significant focus for BBC Sport, and an aspect that Whisper and Timeline TV are embracing.
